## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: "I'm frustrated when [...]

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Amazon Domain (if applicable)

If this is about adding a new Amazon domain, please specify:
- Domain: [e.g. amazon.ca]
- Language: [e.g. English, French, Italian]
- Sender email: [e.g. order-update@amazon.ca]
- Common carriers in your region: [e.g. Canada Post, Purolator, UPS]
